title: Decision Audit and Event Contracts
name: Decision Audit and Event Contracts
summary: Adds durable decision explanations, registered event contracts, an Audit Engine foundation, and permanent regression tests that protect platform release identity and manifest-driven versioning.
changes: Decision Engine v1.2.0 now stores structured, explainable outcomes and emits audited decision records.
Event Engine v1.2.0 validates registered event payload contracts and records event activity.
Audit Engine v1.0.0 provides a reusable local audit history for decisions, events and platform contracts.
Platform Contracts v1.0.0 permanently tests that timestamps cannot cause false synchronization warnings.
Diagnostics Framework v1.2.0 verifies release identity, event contracts and Audit Engine health.
